analyses.name: PO+NO+PC+NC > Sil
analyses.table_caption: Whole-brain random-effects tests of speech content and social relationship processing.
analyses.table_footer: Threshold for reporting for all contrasts was P < 0.001 and whole-brain cluster-corrected P < 0.05 for FWE. All subpeaks at least 10 mm apart are reported for each cluster. L: left, R: right, m: mid, c: caudal, CC: caudal colliculus, CN: caudate nucleus, ESG: ectosylvian gyrus, MGB: medial geniculate body, MTg: mesencephalic tegmentum, SG: Sylvian gyrus, THA: thalamus, n.s.: no significant clusters. PO: praise by the owner, NO: neutral speech by the owner, PC: praise by a control person, NC: neutral speech by a control person, Sil: silence. N = 14.
